title: 朱紫国解心结
subtitle: 把担心说出来，线索就会出现
origin: 《西游记》第六十八至七十一回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 心里有担忧时，倾听、表达和共同寻找线索，比独自忍耐更有力量。
moral.en: When worry feels heavy, listening, speaking honestly, and searching together can bring real strength.

pages.zh: 朱紫国王总望着空座位发呆，饭菜凉了也没发现。
pages.en: The King of Zhuzi kept staring at an empty seat, not noticing his meal had grown cold.
pages.prompt: Kind middle-aged king in plum-and-gold robes sits beside an empty matching chair at a quiet meal; advisors wait gently, no illness drama, no text in image.

pages.zh: 唐僧耐心听他说完：王后在麒麟山失去消息，他一直把担心藏在心里。
pages.en: Tang Seng listened as the king explained that the queen had gone missing near Qilin Mountain, and he had hidden his worry.
pages.prompt: Tang Seng listens at eye level as the king points to a small mountain keepsake beside the empty chair; full team nearby, no text in image.

pages.zh: 悟空在王后留下的丝带上发现三粒金色花粉，正是麒麟山才有的花。
pages.en: Wukong found three grains of golden pollen on the queen's ribbon, from flowers that grew only on Qilin Mountain.
pages.prompt: Close scene of Wukong examining a rose ribbon with three glowing pollen grains while king and team watch; no writing, no text in image.

pages.zh: 山中，金毛星兽请王后帮忙修一只会安抚小动物的紫金铃，却忘了送信。
pages.en: On the mountain, a golden-furred star beast had asked the queen to repair a bell that soothed young animals, but forgot to send word.
pages.prompt: Friendly golden-furred qilin-like star beast with rounded horns watches as an adult queen in rose robes repairs a small purple-gold bell at a bright workshop; no captivity, no text in image.

pages.zh: 王后说自己愿意帮忙，却不愿让家人一直担心。星兽这才明白遗漏了重要一步。
pages.en: The queen wanted to help, but not leave her family worrying. The star beast realized it had missed an important step.
pages.prompt: Queen speaks firmly but kindly to the seated star beast, pointing from repaired bell to a blank message ribbon; open doorway, no threat, no text in image.

pages.zh: 悟空带来国王的回信，大家约定：先报平安，再把最后一颗铃珠装好。
pages.en: Wukong brought the king's reply. Everyone agreed to send news first, then fit the final bead into the bell.
pages.prompt: Wukong delivers a sealed blank reply as queen, star beast, and small woodland animals gather around the nearly finished bell; no readable text, no text in image.

pages.zh: 紫金铃响起柔和清音，山里的小动物安静下来，王后也踏上回城的路。
pages.en: The bell chimed softly, calming the mountain animals, and the queen began her journey home.
pages.prompt: Queen gently rings the small bell while rabbits, deer, and birds relax; star beast carries her travel bag toward a safe path, no text in image.

pages.zh: 国王终于笑了。他在城门设下报平安信箱，让每次远行都少一点牵挂。
pages.en: The king smiled again. He placed a message box at the city gate so future journeys would bring less worry.
pages.prompt: King and queen reunite warmly at the gate beside a decorative blank message box; team and families celebrate calmly, no text in image.
